items.source: Determine whether the Class identified by the supplied className is present and can be loaded and call the action if the Class could be loaded.
items.translation: 确定由提供的 className 标识的 Class 是否存在且能够加载，并在该 Class 可以加载时调用 action。

items.source: Loads the class with the given name using the given ClassLoader.
items.translation: 使用给定的ClassLoader加载给定名称的类。

items.source: Determine whether the given class has a public constructor with the given signature, and return it if available (else return null).
items.translation: 确定给定类是否具有具有给定签名的公共构造函数，如果存在则返回该构造函数（否则返回null）。

items.source: classLoader - the class loader to use (can be null, which indicates the default class loader).
items.translation: classLoader - 要使用的类加载器（可以为 null，表示使用默认类加载器）。

items.source: Utility class to work with classes.

IllegalStateException - if the corresponding class is resolvable but there was a readability mismatch in the inheritance hierarchy of the class (typically a missing dependency declaration in a Jigsaw module definition for a superclass or interface implemented by the class to be checked here)
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果对应的类可解析，但在该类的继承层次结构中出现了可读性不匹配（通常是由于 Jigsaw 模块定义中缺少对当前正在检查的类所实现的超类或接口的依赖声明所致）。

items.source: the Class or null in case the class can't be loaded for any reason.
items.translation: 返回 `Class` 对象，或者如果因任何原因无法加载该类，则返回 null。

items.source: className - the name of the class to check.
name - the name of the class to be loaded.
paramTypes - the parameter types of the method
the constructor, or null if not found
items.translation: 构造函数，或如果未找到则为null

items.source: Oliver Gierke, Mark Paluch, Johannes Englmeier
